text: Level two, question three: a cyclist riding at fifteen kilometres per hour is six kilometres ahead of another riding at eighteen in the same direction; how long does the second take to catch up? Question four: towns P and Q are three hundred and eighty kilometres apart; a car leaves P at eight in the morning for Q at fifty kilometres per hour, and another leaves Q at nine for P at sixty; when and where do they meet? Question five: a thief runs at nine kilometres per hour; a policeman notices ten minutes later and chases at twelve; how far does the thief run before he is caught?
